threigylgueith: treigylgweith (treigylgweith) — on one occasion, once; adverbial noun, apparently treigyl 'turn, occasion' + gweith 'time', the formula of an opening ('once upon a time'); spirant-mutated after a 'and' (A threigylgueith); GPC headword and etymology not certain
gwled: gwledd (gwledd) — feast, banquet; noun f., MW gwled (gwled darparedic 'a prepared feast')
darparedic: darparedig (darparedig) — prepared, made ready; adjective, from darparu 'to prepare' (gwled darparedic 'a feast made ready')
bwyta: bwyta (bwyta) — to eat; verbal noun, used also as a noun 'eating, meal' (gwedy y bwyta kyntaf 'after the first meal')
orymdeith: gorymdaith (gorymdaith) — procession, going-forth, journey; noun f., MW gorymdeith, g dropped by soft mutation after y 'his' (kyuodi y orymdeith 'to rise for his progress'); the exact sense of this idiom is uncertain
gorssed: gorsedd (gorsedd) — mound, seat of judgment or assembly; noun f., here part of the place-name Gorssed Arberth 'the Mound of Arberth'
uch: uwch (uwch) — above, over; preposition, MW uch (uch llaw y llys 'above the court')
llaw: llaw (llaw) — hand; noun f., in the idiom uch llaw 'above, overlooking' (uch llaw y llys 'above the court')
elwit: galw (galw) — to call, name; 3 sg. impersonal imperfect 'was called', with the initial g dropped by soft mutation after relative a (a elwit 'which was called')
kynnedyf: cynneddf (cynneddf) — property, characteristic, quality, custom; noun f. (kynnedyf yr orssed yw 'the property of the mound is')
orssed: gorsedd (gorsedd) — mound; noun f., g dropped by soft mutation after the article yr/'r on a feminine noun (yr orssed 'the mound', y'r orssed 'to the mound')
dylyedauc: dylyedawc — one having a right or standing, a person of rank, noble; noun m./adjective, from dylyu 'to owe, be entitled'; d is probably soft-mutated after pa but the spelling d does not show it (pa dylyedauc bynnac 'whatever man of rank')
eistedo: eistedd (eistedd) — to sit; 3 sg. present subjunctive 'may sit' (a eistedo arnei 'who may sit on it'), indefinite relative with a
nat: na (na) — that ... not; negative particle introducing a negative subordinate clause, spelled nat before a vowel (nat a odyno 'that he does not go from there', a being 3 sg. present of mynet)
odyno: odyno — from there, thence; adverb, o 'from' + yno 'there' (nat a odyno 'that he does not go from there'); modern form not certain
deupeth: deupeth — two things, a pair; compound of deu 'two' + peth 'thing' (heb un o'r deupeth 'without one of the two things')
kymriw: cymriw (cymriw) — wound, hurt, bruise; noun m. (kymriw neu archolleu 'a wound or injuries')
neu: neu — (1) 'or' joining alternatives (kymriw neu archolleu 'wounds or injuries'; neu ynteu 'or else'); (2) the affirmative particle neu/neur 'it is the case that' before a verb (see neir, neut)
archolleu: archoll (archoll) — wound, injury; noun, plural archolleu (kymriw neu archolleu)
rywedawt: rhyfeddod (rhyfeddod) — wonder, marvel; noun m., MW ryuedawt/rywedawt, r written for soft-mutated rh as object of a finite verb (a welei rywedawt 'would see a wonder')
ouyn: ofn (ofn) — fear, dread; noun m., MW ofyn/ouyn (nyt oes arnaf i ouyn 'I have no fear')
cael: cael (caffael) — to get, receive, suffer; verbal noun (ouyn cael kymriw 'fear of getting a wound')
plith: plith (plith) — midst, number; noun m., in ym plith 'among, in the midst of' (ym plith hynn o niuer 'among this host')
ryuedawt: rhyfeddod (rhyfeddod) — wonder, marvel; noun m., written ryuedawt with r for soft-mutated rh (fronted object, so Ryuedawt hagen da oed gennyf 'a wonder, however, I should be glad of'); cause of the soft mutation uncertain
pei: pei (pe) — if; conjunction with the imperfect subjunctive, the radical form (pei ys guelwn 'if I should see it'); also appears mutated (bei, phei) in correlatives
guelwn: gwelet (gweld) — to see; 1 sg. imperfect subjunctive 'I might see, I should see', after pei 'if' (pei ys guelwn 'if I saw it'); gu is the manuscript's spelling of gw
wnath: scribal slip for wnaeth: gwneuthur (gwneud) — to do, make; 3 sg. preterite 'he did', soft-mutated after a (Eisted a wnath 'he sat', lit. 'sitting he did')
bydynt: bot (bod) — to be; 3 sg./3 pl. imperfect habitual 'they were, they used to be' (-ynt = 3 pl.; ual y bydynt yn eisted 'as they were sitting')
welynt: gwelet (gweld) — to see; 3 pl. imperfect 'they saw, they would see' (wynt a welynt 'they saw'), soft-mutated after a
canwelw: canwelw — pale white, shining white; adjective of horse-colour, apparently cann 'white, bright' + gwelw 'pale' (march canwelw mawr aruchel); compound not certain
aruchel: aruchel (aruchel) — lofty, high, tall; adjective (march canwelw mawr aruchel 'a tall, big, pale-white horse')
eureit: euraid (euraid) — golden, of gold; adjective (gwisc eureit 'a golden garment')
prifford: priffordd (priffordd) — highway, main road; noun f., prif 'chief' + ffordd 'road' (ar hyt y prifford 'along the highway')
gerdei: kerdet (cerdded) — to walk, go, travel; 3 sg. imperfect 'went, passed', soft-mutated after relative a (y prifford a gerdei 'the highway that passed')
law: llaw (llaw) — hand; noun f., soft-mutated after heb 'beside, past' (heb law yr orssed 'beside, past the mound')
kerdet: kerdet (cerdded) — walking, travelling, gait, pace; verbal noun used as a noun m./f. (kerdet araf guastat 'a slow, steady pace')
araf: araf (araf) — slow, gentle, calm; adjective (kerdet araf guastat 'a slow steady pace'); equative araued 'as slow as'
gan: gan (gan) — with, by; preposition, expressing possession or experience (oed gan y march 'the horse had', lit. 'was with the horse'; y gan y uarch 'from the horse'); base of gennyf, ganthaw, etc.; soft mutation of a following noun
march: march (march) — horse; noun m., base form (gan y march 'the horse')
ogyuuch: ogyuuch — as high as, up to, level with, near; preposition/adverb taking a/ac (yn dyuot y ogyuuch a'r orssed 'coming up level with the mound'); apparently o + soft-mutated kyuuch; etymology and exact sense uncertain
ohonawch: o (o) + chwi — conjugated preposition 'of you, among you' (2 pl.) (a oes ohonawch 'is there any of you'); the i spaced after it in the text is not explained here
uarchoges: marchoges (marchoges) — horsewoman, lady rider; noun f., soft-mutated after the article y (y uarchoges 'the horsewoman')
aet: mynet (mynd) — to go; 3 sg. imperative 'let him go' (Aet un 'let one go')
herbyn: erbyn (erbyn) — against, to meet, meeting; noun/preposition with h-prefix after y 'her' (yn y herbyn 'to meet her')
ford: ffordd (ffordd) — road, way; noun f., MW ford (yn y ford 'on the road'; yr un ford 'the same road')
athoed: mynet (mynd) — to go; 3 sg. pluperfect 'had gone', spelled athoed for aethoed (neut athoed hi heibaw 'she had gone past'); spelling uncertain
heibaw: heibio (heibio) — past, by; adverb, MW heibaw (neut athoed hi heibaw 'she had gone past')
hymlit: ymlit (ymlid) — to pursue, chase; verbal noun, h-prefix after y 'her' standing for the object of the verbal noun (y hymlit 'to pursue her')
gallei: gallu (gallu) — to be able; 3 sg. imperfect 'he could' (ual y gallei gyntaf 'as quickly as he could')
pedestric: pedestric — going on foot, foot-travel, a footman; noun m. from Latin pedester (o pedestric 'on foot'; ni thykya y pedestric 'going on foot avails nothing'); exact GPC headword uncertain
fei: pei (pe) — if, whatever; the conjunction pei spirant-mutated after a 'and' (a phei), here spelled fei, in a correlative 'the more ... the further' (A fei mwyf uei y urys ef, pellaf uydei hitheu 'however great his haste, the farther she was'); construction not certain
mwyf: scribal slip for mwyaf: mawr (mawr) — big, great; superlative mwyaf 'greatest, most' (A fei mwyf uei y urys ef 'however great his haste was')
urys: brys (brys) — haste, hurry; noun m., soft-mutated after y 'his' (y urys ef 'his haste')
pellaf: pell (pell) — far, distant; superlative pellaf 'furthest' (pellaf uydei hitheu e wrthaw ef 'the further was she from him')
uydei: bot (bod) — to be; 3 sg. imperfect habitual/subjunctive 'would be, used to be', soft-mutated (here after fronted pellaf); (e.g. pellaf uydei hitheu 'the further she would be')
thygyei: tygyaw (tycio) — to avail, be of use; 3 sg. imperfect 'availed', spirant-mutated after na/ni (na thygyei idaw 'that it availed him not'; ni thygyei ymi 'it availed me not')
thykya: tygyaw (tycio) — to avail, be of use; 3 sg. present 'avails', spirant-mutated after ni/ny (ni thykya y pedestric 'going on foot avails not'; ny thykya y neb 'it avails no one')
dos: mynet (mynd) — to go; imperative 2 sg. 'go!' (dos y'r llys 'go to the court')
chymer: kymryt (cymryd) — to take; imperative 2 sg. 'take', spirant-mutated after a 'and' (a chymer y march 'and take the horse')
wypych: gwybot (gwybod) — to know; 2 sg. present subjunctive 'you may know', soft-mutated after relative a (y march kyntaf a wypych 'the first horse that you know of / may find')
hol: ol (ôl) — track, wake, rear; noun m., h-prefix after y 'her' (yn y hol 'in her track, after her')
gymerth: kymryt (cymryd) — to take; 3 sg. preterite 'took', soft-mutated after relative a (y march a gymerth 'the horse he took')
maestir: maestir (maestir) — plain, open country, lowland; noun m. (y maestir guastat 'the level plain')
gauas: cael (caffael) — to get, find; 3 sg. preterite 'got, found', soft-mutated after relative a (y maestir guastat a gauas 'level plain he found')
dangosses: dangos (dangos) — to show; 3 sg. preterite 'showed' (ef a dangosses yr ysparduneu y'r march 'he showed the spurs to the horse', i.e. spurred it); d would be soft-mutated after a, not visible
ysparduneu: ysbardun (ysbardun) — spur; noun m., plural ysparduneu (ysbardunau)
ffei: pei (pe) — if, whatever; spelling of the spirant-mutated conjunction after a 'and' (a ffei = a phei), in the correlative A ffei uwyaf y lladei ef y march, pellaf uydei hitheu 'the harder he struck the horse, the further she was'; construction not certain
uwyaf: mawr (mawr) — big, great; superlative mwyaf 'greatest, most', soft-mutated (m > u) here after the conjunction pei/ffei (e.g. a ffei uwyaf y lladei 'the more he struck')
lladei: lladd (lladd) — to kill, strike; 3 sg. imperfect 'he struck, he would strike' (y lladei ef y march 'he struck the horse'), after relative/particle y
vn: un (un) — one, same; numeral/adjective written vn (yr vn march 'the same horse'; yr vn wisc 'the same dress'; vn gerdet 'one and the same pace'); soft mutation of a following feminine noun
gerdet: kerdet (cerdded) — gait, pace, walking; noun, soft-mutated after vn/yr vn 'one, the same' (vn gerdet 'the same pace'); in amgen urys gerdet 'a different speed of going' the cause of the soft mutation is unclear
dechreuyssei: dechreu (dechrau) — to begin; 3 sg. pluperfect 'had begun' (yr vn gerdet a dechreuyssei hitheu 'the same pace she had begun')
ballwys: pallu (pallu) — to fail, give out; 3 sg. preterite 'failed', soft-mutated after relative a (y uarch ef a ballwys 'his horse failed')
wybu: gwybot (gwybod) — to know, perceive; 3 sg. preterite 'knew, perceived', soft-mutated after phan/pan 'when' (phan wybu ef 'when he perceived')
pallu: pallu (pallu) — to fail, give out; verbal noun 'failing' (ar y uarch pallu 'upon the horse failing')
bedestric: pedestric — soft-mutated after y 'his' (y bedestric 'his foot-travel'); the sense in ar y uarch pallu y bedestric is uncertain (perhaps 'his going on foot, his pace')
ymlit: ymlit (ymlid) — to pursue, chase; verbal noun, base form (ny thykya y neb ymlit yr unbennes 'to pursue the lady avails no one')
unbennes: unbennes — lady, queen, sovereign lady; noun f., feminine of unben 'chief, sovereign' (yr unbennes racco 'yonder lady')
racco: racco — yonder, that over there; demonstrative adverb placed after a noun (yr unbennes racco 'that lady yonder'); GPC headword uncertain
warch: scribal slip for uarch: march (march) — horse; noun m., soft-mutated as object after the subject i (ny wydwn i warch gynt 'I knew no horse swifter'); w printed for u by mistake
gynt: kynt (cynt) — quicker, swifter; comparative 'faster' (warch gynt 'a swifter horse'), soft-mutated for a reason not certain (perhaps predicative after the object)
kyuoyth: kyuoeth (cyfoeth) — realm, dominion, wealth; noun m., spelling kyuoyth (yn y kyuoyth 'in the realm')
ryw: rhyw (rhyw) — kind, sort, some; noun used as an adjective before its noun (ryw ystyr hut 'some magical matter')
ystyr: ystyr (ystyr) — meaning, sense, purpose, matter, affair; noun m. (ryw ystyr hut 'some magical purpose')
hut: hud (hud) — magic, enchantment; noun m., MW hut, here qualifying ystyr (ystyr hut 'a magical matter')
awn: mynet (mynd) — to go; 1 pl. present subjunctive/hortative 'let us go' (awn parth a'r llys 'let us go to the court'), also future 'we shall go' (ni a awn)
doethant: dyuot (dod) — to come; 3 pl. preterite 'they came' (Y'r llys y doethant 'to the court they came')
threulau: treulaw (treulio) — to spend, pass (time); verbal noun, variant spelling treulau, spirant-mutated after a 'and' (a threulau y dyd hwnnw 'and passed that day')
mynet: mynet (mynd) — to go; verbal noun (amser mynet y uwyta 'time to go to eat')
uwyta: bwyta (bwyta) — to eat; verbal noun, soft-mutated after y 'to' (mynet y uwyta 'going to eat')
gwedy: gwedy (gwedi) — after; preposition, spelling variant of guedy (a gwedy y bwyta kyntaf 'and after the first meal')
yniuer: niuer (nifer) — host, company; noun m. with prosthetic y- (see yniueroed); the phrase yr yniuer y buam doe 'the company/place where we were yesterday' is idiomatic and its construction uncertain
buam: bot (bod) — to be; 1 pl. preterite 'we were' (y buam doe 'where we were yesterday')
thidy: tydi (tydi) — you (sg.), emphatic independent pronoun, spirant-mutated t > th after a 'and' (A thidy 'and you')
uakwyueit: makwyf (macwy) — youth, young nobleman, squire; noun m., plural makwyueit, soft-mutated after y 'his' (o'y uakwyueit 'of his squires')
dwg: dwyn (dwyn) — to bring, carry, take; imperative 2 sg. 'bring' (dwg gennyt y march 'bring with you the horse')
mays: maes (maes) — field, open ground; noun m., spelling mays (yn y mays 'in the field, out of doors')
makwyf: makwyf (macwy) — youth, young nobleman, squire; noun m. (y makwyf 'the squire')
gyrchyssant: kyrchu (cyrchu) — to make for, go to, seek; 3 pl. preterite 'they made for', soft-mutated after relative a (yr orssed a gyrchyssant 'the mound they made for')
val: ual (fel) — as, when; conjunction, spelled val here (Ac val y bydynt yn eiste 'and as they sat')
eiste: eistedd (eistedd) — to sit; verbal noun spelled eiste, final d lost (yn eiste 'sitting')
bid: bot (bod) — to be; 3 sg. imperative 'let be' (Bid parawt 'be ready', addressed here to the youth)
parawt: parawd (parod) — ready, prepared; adjective (Bid parawt 'be ready')
was: gwas (gwas) — lad, servant, youth; noun m., soft-mutated as vocative (Ha was 'O lad') or after wrth 'to' (wrth was y uarch 'to the horse's lad')
gywerbyn: kyuerbyn (cyferbyn) — opposite, facing; adverb/preposition taking ac, spelled with w, soft-mutated as an adverb after the verb (a doeth gywerbyn ac wynt 'came opposite them')
yskynnu: ysgynnu (esgyn) — to mount, ascend; verbal noun (yskynnu ar y march 'mounting the horse')
chynn: kyn (cyn) — before; conjunction/preposition + verbal noun, here spelled kynn, spirant-mutated after a 'and' (a chynn daruot 'and before it was done')
daruot: daruot (darfod) — to finish, be done, happen; verbal noun (kynn daruot idaw ymgueiraw 'before he had finished settling himself')
ymgueiraw: ymgweiriaw — to arrange oneself, settle oneself (in the saddle); reflexive verbal noun of cweiriaw 'to set in order, mend' (daruot idaw ymgueiraw yn y gyfrwy 'before he had settled in his saddle'); sense inferred
gyfrwy: cyfrwy (cyfrwy) — saddle; noun m., soft-mutated after y 'his' (yn y gyfrwy 'in his saddle')
neir: scribal slip, reading uncertain, probably for neur (affirmative neu + infixed 'r), 'indeed (it is that) she had already ...' (neir ry adoed hi heibaw 'for she had already gone past'); the reading neir is clear on the page but unexplained
ry: ry (rhy) — perfective verbal particle placed before a verb, giving 'has/had' (ry adoed 'had gone'); causes soft mutation of the verb
adoed: mynet (mynd) — to go; 3 sg. pluperfect 'had gone' (ry adoed hi heibaw 'she had already gone past'); apparently aethoed spelled adoed, spelling uncertain
chynnwll: cynnwll — meaning uncertain, apparently 'a gap, a distance' (a chynnwll y rygthunt 'and a gap between them'); noun, spirant-mutated after a 'and'; the sense is inferred from context only
rygthunt: rwng (rhwng) — between; conjugated preposition 3 pl. 'between them' (y rygthunt 'between them')
rygyng: rhygyng (rhygyng) — gait, run, impetus, rapid pace; noun m. (kymryt rygyng y gan y uarch 'to take a run from his horse'); the sense here is inferred and uncertain
dybygei: tybyaw (tybied) — to suppose, think; 3 sg. imperfect 'he supposed', soft-mutated after a (ef a dybygei 'he supposed')
araued: araf (araf) — slow; equative araued 'as slow as, however slow' (yr araued y kerdei y uarch 'however slowly the horse went')
kerdei: kerdet (cerdded) — to walk, go; 3 sg. imperfect 'went' (y kerdei y uarch 'that the horse went')
ymordiwedei: ymordiwes (goddiwes) — to overtake, catch up with (takes a/ac); 3 sg. imperfect 'would overtake' (yr ymordiwedei a hi 'that he would overtake her'); the particle yr before it is uncertain
thygywys: tygyaw (tycio) — to avail, be of use; 3 sg. preterite 'availed', spirant-mutated after ny (ny thygywys idaw 'it availed him not')
ellwg: ellwng (ellwng) — to let go, loosen, release; verbal noun, MW ellwg (Ellwg y uarch a oruc wrth auwyneu 'he let his horse go on the reins')
auwyneu: afwyn (afwyn) — rein, bridle; noun, plural auwyneu (wrth auwyneu 'by the reins, with loosened reins')
nes: nes (nes) — nearer; comparative of agos 'near' (nyt oed nes idi 'was no nearer to her')
bei: bot (bod) — to be; 3 sg. imperfect subjunctive 'were, might be' (bei ar y gam 'though he were at his stride'), also the soft-mutated form of the conjunction pei 'if'; construction uncertain
phei: pei (pe) — if, whatever; the conjunction spirant-mutated after a 'and' (a phei), in the correlative 'the more ... the further' (a phei wyaf y lladei 'and the harder he struck'); construction not certain
wyaf: probably a slip for uwyaf: mawr (mawr) — big, great; superlative mwyaf 'most' (pei wyaf y lladei 'the more he struck'); not noted in the establishment log, reading probable
cany: cany (canys) — since, for; conjunction, MW cany (cany welas ef 'since he saw'); in this passage the sense needs a negative ('since he saw it did not avail'), so possibly can + ny; uncertain
tygyaw: tygyaw (tycio) — to avail, be of use; verbal noun or stem (cany welas ef tygyaw idaw e hymlit 'since he saw no avail to him in pursuing her'); the negative is implied rather than written
wnaet: scribal slip for wnaeth: gwneuthur (gwneud) — to do, make; 3 sg. preterite 'he did', soft-mutated after a (ymchwelut a wnaet 'he turned back')
allu: gallu (gallu) — power, ability, strength; noun m., g dropped by soft mutation (nyt oes allu 'there is no power'; cause of the mutation uncertain)
weleisti: gwelet (gweld) — to see; 2 sg. preterite 'you saw', soft-mutated after relative a (noc a weleisti 'than what you saw')
herlit: erlit (erlid) — to pursue, persecute; verbal noun, h-prefix after y 'her' (y herlit hi 'to pursue her')
neges: neges (neges) — errand, business, mission; noun f. (yd oed neges idi 'she had an errand')
rei: rhai (rhai) — some, some people; pronoun, MW rei (wrth rei o'r maes hwnn 'with some of this company')
maes: maes (maes) — field, open ground; noun m., here 'company out in the field' (rei o'r maes hwnn 'some of those in this field')
gattei: gadu (gadael) — to leave, allow, let; 3 sg. imperfect subjunctive 'would allow' (pei gattei 'if it would allow')
wrthpwythi: gwrthbwyth? — meaning uncertain, perhaps 'opposition, hindrance' or 'reply, retort' (gwrth 'against' + pwyth 'requital, turn'); soft-mutated after gattei; the form and sense in pei gattei wrthpwythi idi y dywedut are obscure
gerdeu: cerdd (cerdd) — song, poem, music; noun f., plural cerdeu, soft-mutated after drwy 'through' (drwy gerdeu a chyuedach 'with songs and carousing')
llonyd: llonydd (llonydd) — peace, quiet, ease; noun m., MW llonyd (ual y bu llonyd ganthunt 'as it was ease to them')
diuyrru: diuyrru — to pass, spend (time), divert oneself; verbal noun (diuyrru y dyd 'to pass the day'); GPC headword and form uncertain
wwyta: scribal slip for uwyta: bwyta (bwyta) — to eat; verbal noun, soft-mutated after y 'to' (y wwyta for y uwyta 'to eat')
daruu: daruot (darfod) — to finish, be done, happen; 3 sg. preterite 'was finished' (pan daruu udunt y bwyd 'when the meal was done for them')
bwyd: bwyd (bwyd) — food, meal; noun m. (y bwyd 'the meal')
buom: bot (bod) — to be; 1 pl. preterite 'we were' (y buom ni 'we were')
echtoe: echdoe (echdoe) — the day before yesterday; adverb, MW echtoe (doe ac echtoe 'yesterday and the day before')
llymma: llyma (dyma) — behold, here is; presentative particle, spelling variant of llyma (Llymma, Arglwyd 'Here they are, lord')
thitheu: titheu (tithau) — you for your part; 2 sg. conjunctive pronoun, spirant-mutated after a 'and' (A thitheu 'and you, for your part')
kyfrwya: kyfrwyaw (cyfrwyo) — to saddle; imperative 2 sg. 'saddle' (kyfrwya uy march 'saddle my horse')
dabre: dabre — imperative 2 sg.; meaning uncertain, perhaps 'lead out, take, bring forward' (dabre ac ef y'r ford 'take him out to the road'); sense inferred
dwc: dwyn (dwyn) — to bring, carry; imperative 2 sg. 'bring', variant of dwg (dwc uy ysparduneu gennyt 'bring my spurs with you')
gwas: gwas (gwas) — lad, servant, youth; noun m., base form (y gwas 'the lad')
buant: bot (bod) — to be; 3 pl. preterite 'they were' (ny buant 'they were not')
hayach: hayach — any longer, a longer time; probably comparative on hwy 'longer' with -ach, MW hwyach (ny buant hayach o enkyt yno 'they had not been long there'); form uncertain
enkyt: enkyt — a while, a space of time; noun, perhaps a variant of ennyd (o enkyt 'of a while'); uncertain
ha: ha — O, ah; vocative/exclamatory particle (Ha was 'O lad'), soft mutation of the following noun
welaf: gwelet (gweld) — to see; 1 sg. present 'I see', soft-mutated after a (mi a welaf 'I see')
moes: moes — bring, give; irregular imperative 2 sg. (moes uy march 'bring my horse')
kynt: kynt (cynt) — sooner, quicker; comparative adverb (nyt kynt yd yskynn ef noc yd a hitheu 'no sooner does he mount than she goes'); also 'before, formerly'
yskynn: ysgynnu (esgyn) — to mount, ascend; 3 sg. present 'he mounts' (nyt kynt yd yskynn ef ar y uarch 'no sooner does he mount the horse')

troi: troi (troi) — to turn; verbal noun (Troi yn y hol a oruc ef 'he turned in her track')
gadel: gadel (gadael) — to leave, let; verbal noun (gadel y uarch y gerdet 'to let his horse go at its pace')
drythyll: trythyll (trythyll) — wanton, lively, spirited; adjective, soft-mutated (y uarch drythyll 'his lively horse'); cause of the mutation uncertain
llamsachus: llamsachus — leaping, springy, mettlesome; adjective from llamsach 'a leap, bound' (y uarch drythyll llamsachus 'his lively, prancing horse')
neit: naid (naid) — leap, bound; noun f., MW neit (ar yr eil neit 'at the second leap')
trydyd: trydydd (trydydd) — third; ordinal numeral (ar y trydyd 'at the third')
gordiwedei: gordiwes (goddiwes) — to overtake, catch up with; 3 sg. imperfect 'would overtake' (y gordiwedei 'that he would overtake her')
gymhellaud: kymell (cymell) — to urge, impel, drive; 3 sg. preterite 'urged', soft-mutated after relative a (y uarch a gymhellaud 'he urged his horse')
mwyaf: mawr (mawr) — big, great; superlative mwyaf 'greatest, most' (o'r kerdet mwyaf a oed ganthaw 'at the greatest speed he had')
guelet: gwelet (gweld) — to see; verbal noun, spelled with gu (a guelet a wnaeth 'and he saw')
uorwyn: morwyn (morwyn) — maiden, young woman; noun f., soft-mutated as vocative (A uorwyn 'O maiden'), after the article (y uorwyn) and after o 'of' (o uorwyn 'of any maiden')
mwyn: mwyn (mwyn) — sake, favour, kindness; noun m., in yr mwyn 'for the sake of' (modern er mwyn); also adjective 'gentle'
mwyhaf: mawr (mawr) — big, great; superlative mwyaf 'greatest, most', spelled mwyhaf (y gwr mwyhaf a gery 'the man you love most')
gery: caru (caru) — to love; 2 sg. present 'you love', soft-mutated after relative a (a gery 'whom you love')
arho: arhos (aros) — to wait, stay; imperative 2 sg. 'wait' (arho ui 'wait for me')
arhoaf: arhos (aros) — to wait, stay; 1 sg. present/future 'I will wait' (Arhoaf yn llawen 'I will gladly wait')
llessach: llessach — more beneficial, better, more profitable; comparative apparently formed on lles 'benefit' (oed llessach y'r march 'it would be better for the horse'); base form uncertain
ass: ass — infixed 3 sg. object pronoun 's 'it, her' with vowel support and doubled s (pei ass archut 'if you were to ask it'); written together with archut in Evans; analysis uncertain
archut: erchi (erchi) — to ask, request; 2 sg. imperfect subjunctive 'you were to ask' (pei ass archut 'if you were to ask it')
meityn: meityn — a while ago, earlier, formerly; adverb (yr meityn 'for a good while, since early'); sense inferred, uncertain
sewyll: sefyll (sefyll) — to stand, halt, stop; verbal noun (Sewyll ac arhos a oruc y uorwyn 'the maiden stopped and waited')
arhos: arhos (aros) — to wait, stay; verbal noun (sewyll ac arhos 'stopping and waiting')
gwaret: gwared (gwared) — to remove, put aside, deliver; verbal noun gwaret (gwaret y rann ... o wisc y phenn 'putting aside the part of her head-dress')
rann: rhan (rhan) — part, portion; noun f., MW rann (y rann a dylyei uot am y hwyneb 'the part that ought to be about her face')
hwyneb: wyneb (wyneb) — face; noun m., h-prefix after y 'her' (am y hwyneb 'about her face')
phenn: penn (pen) — head; noun m., spirant-mutated after y 'her' (gwisc y phenn 'her head-dress')
attal: attal (atal) — to hold, stop, fix; verbal noun (attal y golwc arnaw 'fixing her gaze on him')
golwc: golwc (golwg) — look, gaze, sight; noun m. (attal y golwc arnaw 'fixing her gaze on him')
doy: dyuot (dod) — to come; 2 sg. present 'you come' (pan doy di 'whence do you come')
negesseu: neges (neges) — errand, business; noun f., plural negesseu (o'th negesseu 'of your errands')
welet: gwelet (gweld) — to see; verbal noun, soft-mutated after dy 'your' (dy welet ti 'to see you')
crassaw: croesaw (croeso) — welcome; noun m., MW crassaw (Crassaw wrthyt y gennyf i 'welcome to you from me')
diuwyn: diuwyn — plain, dull, insignificant (by comparison); adjective, probably di- 'without' + gwyn 'white, fair' (bot yn diuwyn ganthaw pryt 'that the form seemed dull to him'); sense inferred, uncertain
ffryt: ffryt — meaning uncertain, perhaps 'beauty, brightness, course'; noun (y wrth y ffryt hi 'compared with her ...'); GPC headword uncertain
pennaf: pen (pen) — head, chief; superlative pennaf 'chief, principal' (pennaf neges 'the chief errand')
keissaw: keissyaw (ceisio) — to seek; verbal noun (keissaw dy welet ti 'to seek to see you')
pwll: scribal slip for Pwyll: Pwyll — proper name, the tale's protagonist; means 'sense, discretion' (heb y Pwll 'said Pwyll')
oreu: goreu (gorau) — best; superlative of da 'good', g dropped by soft mutation after a feminine noun (y neges oreu 'the best errand')
riannon: Riannon (Rhiannon) — proper name, daughter of Heueyd Hen and later Pwyll's wife; the etymology 'great queen' (Celtic *rigantona) is conjectural
uerch: merch (merch) — daughter; noun f., soft-mutated in apposition after a personal name (Riannon uerch Heueyd 'Riannon daughter of Heueyd')
heueyd: Heueyd (Hefeydd) — proper name, father of Riannon, Heueyd Hen 'Heueyd the Old'; meaning unknown
hen: hen (hen) — old; adjective, here an epithet after a name (Heueyd Hen 'Heueyd the Old')
hanwod: anuod (anfodd) — unwillingness, displeasure; noun m., MW anuod/anwod, with prothetic h- after 'm 'my' (o'm hanwod 'against my will'; cause of the h uncertain)
ydys: bot (bod) — to be; impersonal present 'one is, is being done' (yd ydys, in a'm rodi y wr ... yd ydys 'I am being given to a husband')
mynneis: mynnu (mynnu) — to wish, want, desire; 1 sg. preterite 'I wanted' (ny mynneis 'I did not want')
garyat: caryat (cariad) — love, beloved; noun m., soft-mutated after 'th 'your' (o'th garyat 'out of love for you')
mynnaf: mynnu (mynnu) — to wish, want; 1 sg. present 'I want' (nys mynnaf 'I do not want him')
etwa: etwa (eto) — yet, still, again; adverb (nys mynnaf etwa 'I do not want one yet')
onyt: onyt (oni) — unless, if not; conjunction, MW onyt (onyt ti a'm gwrthyt 'unless it be you who refuse me')
gwrthyt: gwrthod (gwrthod) — to reject, refuse; 2 sg. present (relative or subjunctive; ending -yt) 'you reject' (ti a'm gwrthyt 'you who reject me')
deuthum: dyuot (dod) — to come; 1 sg. preterite 'I came' (e deuthum i 'I came')
caffwn: cael (caffael) — to get, have; 1 sg. imperfect subjunctive 'I might get' (pei caffwn dewis 'if I could have a choice')
dewis: dewis (dewis) — choice; also to choose; noun m./verbal noun (caffwn dewis 'I might have my choice')
wraged: gwreic (gwraig) — woman, wife; noun f., plural gwraged, soft-mutated after holl (ar holl wraged 'of all the women')
morynnyon: morwyn (morwyn) — maiden, young woman; noun f., plural morynnyon (holl wraged a morynnyon y byt 'all the women and maidens of the world')
dewisswn: dewis (dewis) — to choose; 1 sg. imperfect subjunctive 'I would choose' (y mae ti a dewisswn 'it is you whom I would choose')
os: os (os) — if; conjunction with the indicative (os hynny a uynny 'if you wish that')
uynny: mynnu (mynnu) — to wish, want; 2 sg. present 'you wish', soft-mutated after relative a (os hynny a uynny 'if you wish that')
kyn: kyn (cyn) — before; conjunction/preposition + verbal noun (kyn uy rodi y wr arall 'before I am given to another man')
gwna: gwneuthur (gwneud) — to do, make; imperative 2 sg. 'make, do' (gwna oed a mi 'make an appointment with me')
goreu: da (da) — good; superlative goreu 'best' (Goreu yw gennyf i 'best it is to me, I prefer')
mynnych: mynnu (mynnu) — to wish, want; 2 sg. present subjunctive 'you may wish' (y mynnych ti 'where you may wish')
barawt: parawd (parod) — ready, prepared; adjective, soft-mutated after yn (yn barawt 'in readiness')
tric: trigaw (trigo) — to stay, dwell; imperative 2 sg. 'stay' (tric yn iach 'farewell', lit. 'stay well')
iach: iach (iach) — healthy, well, whole; adjective (yn iach 'in good health, farewell')
choffa: cofio (cofio) — to remember; imperative 2 sg. 'remember' (MW coffau), spirant-mutated after a 'and' (a choffa 'and remember')
gywiraw: kywiraw (cywiro) — to set right, make good, fulfil; verbal noun, soft-mutated (coffa gywiraw dy edewit 'remember to fulfil your promise'); cause uncertain
edewit: edewit (addewid) — promise; noun, MW edewit (dy edewit 'your promise')

__broaden__.a: a — (1) preverbal/relative particle before a verb, causes soft mutation (Pwyll … a oed; ef a welei); (2) 'and' before a consonant, spirant mutation (a chanu, a fob); (3) 'with' (a'y gydymdeithon; gyt a thi); (4) vocative particle (A unben); (5) 'whoever, what' before a verb (a del 'whoever may come'; a wnaethost 'what you did') · (6) 3 sg. present of mynet 'goes' (nat a odyno 'that he does not go from there'); (7) in a'y kymriw neu archolleu perhaps 'either, or' (ai), reading uncertain
__broaden__.y: y — (1) the article 'the' (y llys); (2) 'his, her, its' (y uryt: soft mutation = his; y hymdidan: h-prefix = her); (3) 'to' (y hela, y gyuoeth); (4) preverbal particle after a fronted adverb or object (yno y bu, Pwyll... a oed); (5) the relative in oblique relations (o'r a welsei) · (6) 'from' in y gan 'from' and y wrth 'from' (y gan y uarch 'from the horse', y wrth y ffryt hi 'from/compared with her ...'); (7) infixed object 'him, her, it' after relative a (a'y guelei 'who saw her')
__broaden__.yr: yr — (1) the article 'the' before a vowel (yr erchwys); (2) 'for, for the sake of' preposition (yr Duw 'for God's sake', yr guaret gormes 'for removing the oppression') · (3) 'however, although' before a clause or equative (yr araued y kerdei 'however slowly it went'); (4) 'for, since' in yr meityn 'for a good while, long since'
__broaden__.arnei: ar — conjugated preposition 'on her' (a charyat arnei 'and love on her') · also 'on it' (f.), referring to a feminine noun (a eistedo arnei 'who may sit on it', of the mound)
__broaden__.welei: gwelet (gweld) — to see; 3 sg. imperfect 'he saw' (welei), soft-mutated after a (ef a welei lannerch) · also habitual or conditional 'would see' (neu ynteu a welei rywedawt 'or else would see a wonder')
__broaden__.ys: ys (ys) — 'it is'; copula particle introducing a predicate, esp. in time expressions (ys blwydyn 'it is a year' = for a year) · also infixed 3 sg. object 's 'it' after a particle (pei ys guelwn 'if I should see it')
__broaden__.uarch: march (march) — horse; noun m., soft-mutated after ar (y ar uarch erchlas mawr 'on a big dapple-grey horse') · also soft-mutated after y 'his' (y uarch 'his horse')
__broaden__.hyt: hyt (hyd) — as far as, until; preposition/conjunction (hyt ym penn y ulwydyn 'until the year's end'; hyt na bo 'so that there be not') · also in ar hyt 'along, by way of' (ar hyt y prifford 'along the highway')
__broaden__.guastat: guastat (gwastad) — level, flat; adjective (o uaes guastat 'of a level field') · also 'steady, even' of a pace (Kerdet araf guastat 'a slow, steady pace')
__broaden__.uryt: bryt (bryd) — mind, intent; noun m., soft-mutated after y 'his' (yn y uryt 'into his mind') · also in ar uryt 'in the view of, to the mind of' (ar uryt y neb a'y guelei 'to the mind of anyone who saw it'), soft after ar
__broaden__.neb: neb (neb) — anyone; pronoun, used with a positive sense in relative/superlative clauses (o'r a welsei neb 'that anyone had seen') · also 'anyone' under a negative = 'no one' (ny thykya y neb ymlit 'it avails no one to pursue')
__broaden__.wybot: gwybot (gwybod) — knowledge, discernment; noun m. used substantively (ny bu gystal dy wybot 'your judgement was never so good') · also verbal noun 'to know, find out', soft-mutated after y 'to' (y wybot pwy yw 'to find out who she is')
__broaden__.gyntaf: kyntaf (cyntaf) — first; superlative, soft-mutated after y (ar y gossot kyntaf 'at the first onset') · also adverbial 'soonest, as soon as possible' (ual y gallei gyntaf 'as quickly as he could'), soft-mutated as an adverb
__broaden__.e: y — 'his', spelt e before a following consonant or in some spellings: e gwn 'his dogs', e weneb 'his face'; also the preposition 'to' in e uynet 'to go' · also 'from' in e wrthaw 'from him' (= y wrthaw, pellaf uydei hitheu e wrthaw ef 'the further was she from him')
__broaden__.wrthaw: wrth (wrth) + ef — conjugated preposition 'to/at him' (a dywedut ual hynn wrthaw) · also in y wrthaw/e wrthaw 'from him, away from him'
__broaden__.mae: bot (bod) — to be; irregular present 3 sg. 'is, there is' (y mae arnat o anryded) · also interrogative 'where is' (Mae yr yniuer? 'where is the company?')
__broaden__.wisc: gwisc (gwisg) — garment, dress; noun f., soft-mutated after yn/predicative (yn wisc hela 'as a hunting dress') · also soft-mutated as a feminine noun after yr vn 'the same' (a'r vn wisc amdanei 'and the same dress about her')
__broaden__.gam: cam (cam) — wrong; noun m., soft-mutated as object (o gwneuthum gam 'if I did wrong') · also cam 'step, stride, pace' (nyt oed nes idi no chynt bei ar y gam 'she was no nearer than before even at his stride'), reading uncertain
__broaden__.cherdet: kerdet (cerdded) — to walk, go; verbal noun, spirant-mutated after a (a cherdet yn ol y cwn 'and going after the hounds') · also noun 'pace, gait', spirant-mutated after y 'her' (y cherdet hitheu 'her pace')
__broaden__.oet: oet (oed) — appointed time, tryst; noun m. (y mae oet y rof i ac ef 'there is an appointment between me and him') · also spelling of oed 3 sg. imperfect of bot 'was' (yn yd oet Pwyll 'to where Pwyll was')
__broaden__.dylyei: dylyu (dylu) — to owe, deserve; 3 sg. imperfect, negated 'would not deserve' (ual nas dylyei 'such that it would not deserve it') · also positive 'ought, was due' (y rann a dylyei uot am y hwyneb 'the part that ought to be about her face')
__broaden__.pan: pan (pan) — when; temporal conjunction with a past-time clause (pan doeth) · also interrogative 'whence' (pan doy di 'where do you come from')
__broaden__.o: o (o) — (1) 'of, from' preposition; (2) 'if' before a verb (o gwneuthum gam 'if I did wrong') · also 'by, from, out of, among' (o pedestric 'on foot'; o'th garyat ti 'out of love for you'; pryt ... o uorwyn 'any form of maiden')
__broaden__.un: un (un) — one; numeral/adjective (un dyrnaut 'one blow') · also 'same' (yn un ansawd 'in one and the same condition'; yr un ford 'the same road') and pronoun 'one (of them)' (Un a gyuodes 'one rose')
__broaden__.yn: yn — (1) 'in' (yn Arberth; nasal mutation: yn nyblyc); (2) predicative 'as' with soft mutation (yn wisc hela, yn arglwyd); (3) with a verbal noun, progressive (yn dyuot 'coming'); (4) before an adjective, adverbial (yn llawen 'gladly') · (5) yn yd 'to where, in which' (ymchwelut yn yd oed Pwyll 'turned back to where Pwyll was')
__broaden__.heb: heb — (1) 'said' (heb ef 'said he'), a defective verb used only for tagging speech; (2) 'without' + verbal noun (heb hanbwyllaw 'without troubling') · (3) 'past, by' in heb law yr orssed 'beside, past the mound'; idiom uncertain
__broaden__.m: 'm — infixed/proclitic pronoun, apostrophe half of a'm, y'm, o'm etc.: 'my' (possessive, triggers soft mutation) or 'me' (object) · before a vowel an h appears, as in o'm hanwod 'against my will' (cause uncertain); also 'me' as infixed object (a'm rodi 'and gave me'; a'm gwrthyt 'who reject me')
